items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I went with Charlie Bes-, Charlie Miller, then I s-, I mean with Charlie Johnson and I stayed with that band 10 years

ctx.x: I talked with him many, many times, fortunately.

Well, he could tell you about this band down in Philadelphia, it only lasted two weeks. It's only two weeks, that's all, and then it closed. Then I went with Charlie Bes-, Charlie Miller, then I s-, I mean with Charlie Johnson and I stayed with that band 10 years [ ].
Well, we'll get back to that point, but we've got a story to tell about Boston. Now you go up to Boston, and you're going to study piano and harmony and theory at the New England Conservatory.
